features.text: The patient is 52 years old.
The patient is here for their annual exam.
The patient has been experiencing palpitations, especially when stressed.
The palpitations have been happening occasionally, with the last episode about a week ago.
The palpitations occur more when the patient is stressed.
The patient has tried meditation and running with their dog to manage the palpitations, but it hasn't worked.
The patient does not have chest pain, dizziness, or shortness of breath during the palpitations.
The patient has a history of rheumatoid arthritis.
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a history of reflux.
The patient is on methotrexate for rheumatoid arthritis.
The patient does not have allergies.
The patient does not know their family history of cardiac conditions.
The patient had an event monitor done last month.
The event monitor showed the patient is going in and out of atrial fibrillation with conversion pauses.
The patient does not have specific symptoms during atrial fibrillation episodes other than the feeling of their heart racing.
The patient does not remember the exact frequency or duration of the atrial fibrillation episodes.
